brief:
Israeli Foreign Minister stated his government does not seek escalation with Turkey and prefers diplomatic solutions to any disputes, according to Maan Wire. At the same time, he made clear that Israel will not accept Turkish military bases in Syria or allow Turkish forces to advance into southern Syrian territory.

The minister's remarks underscore Jerusalem's concerns about potential Turkish military expansion near its borders as Syria's political landscape shifts. Israel has long viewed Turkish military presence in neighboring Syria as a strategic threat to its security interests in the region.
